request_encoding_notes: Every call is HTTP POST with a raw-text body 'jData=' + JSON object. No Content-Type header required. Header 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>' on all endpoints except GenAcsTok.
response_conventions: JSON; check stat (Ok / Not_Ok) first; emsg present when Not_Ok; request_time when returned. Business errors often arrive with HTTP 200. 401/403 = missing/invalid Bearer token; 429 = too many requests.
rate_limit_notes: Per official #rate-limits: all other REST APIs have no rate limit (still avoid unnecessary polling). PlaceMultiOrder is named only in the rate-limit section and has no reference page. WebSocket: max 1,000 subscriptions per user / connection.
